title: Qualify provider portability and fallback
businessObjective: Permit future API, local-model, or other providers without weakening policy, data controls, evidence, or availability handling.
technicalObjective: Define and verify provider conformance, capability, structured-output, data-classification, provider-state, failure, audit, and fallback-eligibility tests against the canonical provider-neutral interfaces.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No provider fallback is enabled merely by completing qualification.
OpenAI API, local-model, and other providers require separate approved adapter and credential tasks.
No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: A conformance suite evaluates IntelligenceProvider, ProposalGenerator, ExecutorAdapter where applicable, and VerificationProvider compatibility without provider-specific authority.

Qualification covers schema validity, deterministic malformed-output rejection, capability declarations, data-classification eligibility, timeout/cancellation, audit attribution, and all canonical provider states.
Fallback remains disabled unless explicitly configured and policy-authorized for the task, data, requested capabilities, and independent verification route.
Unavailable or failed primary and fallback providers pause or safely requeue, preserve both reasons, notify staff where appropriate, and cannot trigger production changes.
No provider can verify its own execution as the sole completion authority.
solEscalationTriggers: Any provider or fallback would receive broader data, capabilities, credentials, execution rights, or authority than the primary contract permits.
Any production access, privacy, authentication, authorization, payment, booking, RLS, migration, or independent-verification ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Disable fallback configuration and revert the provider-conformance branch; preserve qualification and failure evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Added by GOV-032 to make provider migration and fallback explicit, qualified, and fail closed.
